headline: **MLB Daily Roundup: July 4, 2026**
article:
The St. Louis Cardinals made a statement with a dominant 17-1 victory over the Chicago Cubs, led by Masyn Winn's 2-hit, 1-home run, 4-RBI performance. Elsewhere, the Washington Nationals secured a 9-5 win over the Pittsburgh Pirates, while the New York Yankees took down the Minnesota Twins 5-2 behind Gerrit Cole's strong outing.

Injuries continue to plague several teams, with the San Diego Padres placing Freddy Fermin on the 10-day injured list due to a head contusion. The Seattle Mariners' Julio Rodríguez has been sidelined with a concussion, while the Baltimore Orioles' Ryan Helsley is dealing with right elbow discomfort. The Houston Astros' Bennett Sousa has been transferred to the 60-day injured list with left elbow inflammation.

The Washington Nationals made a move to bolster their pitching staff, acquiring left-handed pitcher Tom Cosgrove in a trade with the Houston Astros for cash considerations. The Nationals also acquired right-handed pitcher Kyle Nicolas from the Baltimore Orioles in exchange for shortstop Randal Diaz.

top_news.title: **Cardinals Rout Cubs 17-1 in Dominant Performance**
top_news.summary: The St. Louis Cardinals secured a convincing 17-1 victory over the Chicago Cubs, behind a strong outing from Andre Pallante. Masyn Winn led the Cardinals' offense with a 2-hit, 1-home run, 4-RBI performance.

top_news.title: **Nationals Take Down Pirates 9-5**
top_news.summary: The Washington Nationals secured a 9-5 victory over the Pittsburgh Pirates, with Foster Griffin earning the win. Daylen Lile led the Pirates' offense with 3 hits, 2 home runs, and 4 RBIs.

top_news.title: **Yankees Take Down Twins 5-2**
top_news.summary: The New York Yankees secured a 5-2 victory over the Minnesota Twins, with Gerrit Cole earning the win after pitching 5.0 innings with 7 strikeouts and 2 earned runs. Trent Grisham led the Twins' offense with 2 hits, 1 home run, and 2 RBIs.

top_news.title: **Orioles Shut Out Reds in Dominant Performance**
top_news.summary: The Baltimore Orioles secured a 3-0 victory over the Cincinnati Reds, with Trevor Rogers earning the win after 5.0 innings of work. Samuel Basallo led the Orioles' offense with a home run and 2 RBI.

top_news.title: **Padres Place Freddy Fermin on 10-Day Injured List**
top_news.summary: San Diego Padres catcher Freddy Fermin has been placed on the 10-day injured list due to a head contusion. The move was made on July 3, 2026.

top_news.title: **Nationals Acquire Left-Handed Pitcher Tom Cosgrove**
top_news.summary: The Washington Nationals have made a move to bolster their pitching staff, acquiring left-handed pitcher Tom Cosgrove in a trade with the Houston Astros. The deal was reportedly made for cash considerations.
